title: bobreviewer probe
description: Committed probe file under .bobreviewer/probes/ or probes/ (legacy)

target.description: Fully-qualified dotted name of the function under test, e.g. mypackage.billing.calculate_invoice

id.description: Stable unique identifier for this case within the probe file

args.description: Positional arguments passed to the target function

kwargs.description: Keyword arguments passed to the target function

fixture.description: When true, this probe is illustrative/test data and must never be treated as real execution evidence
